items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow, ruled out; X-rays negative no fracture, additional testing Monday, expected to miss time (prior similar injury ~1 month).
items.why: HC Dan Quinn confirmation; carted off after awkward fall.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade ROS short-term; backup elevated, WRs/TE impacted.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps; reduced efficiency for pass catchers.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE for Week 2 after being a game-time decision with optimism and possible flak jacket.
items.why: Official inactive list confirmation; prior RapSheet bullish tone and ETR/Levitan projection in with docks.
items.implication: Start with reduced volume risk due to injury docks; flak jacket possible.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets expected but docked for rib issue.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive for Week 2; was not expected to play.
items.why: Official confirmation matching ETR summary and Levitan notes.
items.implication: Opens backfield looks; grab handcuff immediately.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers inactive/out Week 2 (knee); HC Kubiak says 'close, very close, looks great' for return soon.
items.implication: Michael Mayer elevated short-term; stash Bowers.

items.text: Sunday injury watchlist: Caleb Williams (hamstring), Jayden Daniels (dislocated elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Mike Evans (hip not serious), plus Brooks/Dowdle/Jones/Dobbins/Goedert others.
items.why: Comprehensive postgame summary of key fantasy injuries.
items.opportunity: Role changes if any miss time.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans has hip injury, questionable to return; Shanahan says doesn't look serious (Demarcus Robinson high ankle).
Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; walking under own power no crutches, slight limp possible, tests Monday.
items.why: Team announcement; Rapoport notes good spirits walking.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 3; backup if misses.
items.opportunity: Potential limited or backup snaps next week.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason. Agrees Germie Bernard stash (YAC/McCarthy fit) with Pittman out.
items.why: Active/inactive confirm + preseason stance on Coleman; Bernard YAC fit.
items.implication: Immediate adds for depth; McConkey green light.
items.opportunity: Backup RB/WR snaps and YAC usage.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck/head) ruled out.
items.implication: Target bump to other GB WRs.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return in game.
Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) is ACTIVE vs Texans after being questionable/expected to play.
items.why: Official active list; Rapoport earlier 'will play'.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is ACTIVE; ETR/Levitan saw clean with no docks.
Puka Nacua (hip/groin) is true game-time decision for MNF; Schefter notes trending wrong direction, more likely out.
items.implication: Have pivot ready; Adams/others elevated if out.
items.opportunity: If out, more targets to Davante Adams and TEs.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status late. Olave clean no docks. Harvey doubtful opens Jonah Coleman look; Pittman out opens Germie Bernard.
items.why: Injury docks data + source tone; projections updated for news.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups on OUT players.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT; opens door for Bateman and others.
Michael Pittman (foot) is OUT; Levitan/Berry eye Germie Bernard for looks/YAC fit with McCarthy.
items.why: Confirmed in ETR summary and inactives.

items.text: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba: 9/155/3 TDs; 5th WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yards, TD in each of first two games.
items.why: Stat line confirmation of elite early usage.
items.implication: WR1 lock ROS; high target share.

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return with chest injury.
